maddeler.e:
ازدرعن (form VIII)
# اِزْدَرَعْنَ (izdaraʕna) /iz.da.raʕ.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِزْدَرَعَ (izdaraʕa)
# اُزْدُرِعْنَ (uzduriʕna) /uz.du.riʕ.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِزْدَرَعَ (izdaraʕa)
# اِزْدَرِعْنَ (izdariʕna) /iz.da.riʕ.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِزْدَرَعَ (izdaraʕa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
